project_identity.name: UniMatch — University & Scholarship Decision Engine
project_identity.aesthetic_style: Linear / Notion / Fintech Dashboard minimal hybrid
project_identity.gradient_policy: STRICTLY NO GRADIENTS. Solid tone surfaces, 1px precision borders, high visual contrast
project_identity.target_user: Student seeking fit-oriented global university recommendations and scholarships

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace

heading_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-900 leading-tight
heading_rules.overlines: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-zinc-500 font-medium

status_verified.badge: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-200 font-mono text-xs font-medium

status_estimated.badge: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 font-mono text-xs font-medium

layout_and_spacing.padding_philosophy: Generous Notion-style padding. 1px solid borders for visual hierarchy instead of drop shadows.

grid_modes.dashboard_mode: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

layout_and_spacing.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-zinc-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-none
layout_and_spacing.sidebar_nav: w-64 border-r border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50/50 p-4 min-h-screen

component_strategies.profile_wizard: Multi-step progress header with steps (1. Academic, 2. Budget & Aid, 3. Target Programs & Location, 4. Standardized Tests & Requirements). Uses Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Slider, Switch.
component_strategies.fit_score_badge: Pill-shaped badge with numerical fit score (e.g. 94%), confidence bar indicator, and Verified/Estimated status badge.
component_strategies.university_recommendation_card: Clean Notion/Linear card with 1px border. Shows University logo/badge, location, QS ranking, fit score ring/bar, key tuition/deadline stats with source tooltips, and 'Why This Match?' toggle.
component_strategies.why_this_match_drawer: Collapsible panel showing weighted breakdown across 7 dimensions: Academic (25%), Budget (20%), Scholarship (20%), Requirements (15%), Program (10%), Location (5%), Ranking (5%). Includes explainable text bullet points.
component_strategies.side_by_side_compare: Sticky top comparison matrix for 2 to 5 universities with spec diff highlighting, missing field confidence indicators, and mobile tabbed switch.
component_strategies.timeline_widget: Vertical deadline timeline with interactive filter (Application, Financial Aid, Scholarship, Visa) and color-coded urgency indicators.
component_strategies.saved_shortlist: Kanban or tabular list with private note fields, decision status flags (Considering, Applying, Submitted), and action buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Linear/Notion dashboard aesthetics strictly: clear 1px borders (border-zinc-200), zero soft radial gradients, zero decorative dark backgrounds.
Ensure every data point displays a source label and a Verified (emerald pill) or Estimated (amber pill) status tag.
Implement the multi-step Profile Wizard with immediate live validation and step completion indicator.
Build 'Why This Match?' breakdown dialog/drawer detailing exact academic, financial, and requirement calculations with clear explanations.
Include data-testid on all interactive components (e.g., data-testid='university-card-compare-btn', data-testid='fit-score-breakdown-btn').
Ensure side-by-side comparison supports floating toolbar when selecting 2 to 5 universities.
Maintain responsive layouts with mobile tabbed fallback for complex tabular data.
Use Lucide icons throughout with crisp 1.5px stroke width.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='profile-completeness-ring').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_gradients: Do not apply CSS gradients or backdrop gradients anywhere in the application.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high contrast standards (APCA/WCAG AA compliant) across all badge states and text elements.
